title: Daily ledger — October 2026 month pass
summary: Read every October conversation in full, scanned all 28 repos the month touched, checked three outside sources, and appended 226 vetted entries to the Bug Ledger. Bugs went from 895 to 1,055 and optimisers from 368 to 434. The ledger is live and pushed.

tasks.desc: 179 transcripts were touched in October; 67 had real October messages. 4 Bug Ledger meta-sessions were skipped.

tasks.text: Wave 1 — Read every conversation and extract new items
tasks.desc: 63 conversations read to the end by 9 readers, producing 301 candidates.

tasks.text: Wave 2 — Run the detector suite over October's repos
tasks.desc: 28 repos scanned: 2,096 findings. Three were verified in source and filed as their own entries.
Veracode 2026, WebAIM Million 2026 and OWASP Agentic Top 10 checked at source. Two Cloudflare claims from search did not verify and were not filed.

tasks.text: Wave 4 — Dedupe and append to the ledger
tasks.desc: 66 candidates were already in the ledger or the live agent-submitted table, 9 were pruned by hand, 226 appended. The diff is additions only.
gen.mjs, wrangler deploy (version eb70e06c), commit c12729b pushed.

tasks.text: Wave 5 — Verify live and publish the report
tasks.desc: Live site shows 1,055 bugs and 434 optimisers; new entries confirmed in the served bugs.json and data-opt.js.
